1580-4871-5670-6794.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5670-6794.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Susurian Voidborn and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1903-5078-6766-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1170-1477-5131-7753--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-5131-7753--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-3129-4094-4826-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2103-2239-7370.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Ardent Elementalist.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from exile to the battlefield.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1116-1263-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4091-6479-7791.description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat.

1563-2079-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-2079-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-2079-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-997-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
978-997-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

997-1734-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1734-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

104-4094-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-4094-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1183-2347-4853.description:
Activate Firemind Vessel by tapping it, adding {2}
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Firemind Vessel.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

681-1315-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-1315-6621-6664.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 2.

1829-2173-2438-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-1115-4050.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4222-5268-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

63-290-1651-4013.description:
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters, it triggers twice, creating at least two Clue tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat.
63-290-1651-4013.notes: Because your opponents must choose to either let themselves and you investigate, or lose life, this combo will very likely result in infinite Clue tokens for you and your opponents.

813-3556-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-3556-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

722-3153-6472.notablePrerequisites: Deceptive Frostkite is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
722-3153-6472.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

152-5921-6252.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
152-5921-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

222-413-527-969.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-969.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

586-3967-4314-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pawn of Ulamog and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

678-5231-5553.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, adding {R}.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2178-2407-5158.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Sorceress Queen.
Sorceress Queen does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2407-5158.description:
Activate Sorceress Queen by tapping it, causing a creature an opponent controls to have base power and toughness 0/2 until end of turn.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness because of Elesh Norn's static effect, triggering Sorceress Queen, untapping Sorceress Queen.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

997-2035-2523.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gollum.
When Gollum dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a  nonlegendary token copy of Gollum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Gollum trigger from step 2, causing the Ring to tempt you, and for the Gollum token to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2512-3405-4594.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Spirit en-Kor ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Spirit en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Daru Spiritualist instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Ayli's first ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2506-3337-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Fable of the Mirror-Breaker has exactly two lore counters on it.
"Goblin" or "Shaman" chosen with Molten Echoes.
2506-3337-4050.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker triggers, causing you to put a lore counter on it.
Fable of the Mirror-Breaker's third chapter ability triggers, exiling it, and returning it to the battlefield as Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
When Reflection of Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of Reflection of Kiki-Jiki with haste.
Activate the token Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the nontoken Reflection of Kiki-Jiki with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the tapped Reflection of Kiki-Jiki token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 4.

7-708-2500-2931-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with a +1/+1 counter on them.
7-708-2500-2931-5256.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Faceless One from the command zone by paying {0}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Faceless One.
Choose to return Faceless One to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the ability from step 3, milling target player three cards.
Repeat from step 2.

1702-3212-4872.description:
Activate Jace's zero loyalty ability, putting Time Warp on top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Time Warp, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {1}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.

364-1987-3277-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
